hero.tagline: Run AI agents on your own infrastructure. Own your data forever.
hero.description: Deploy a complete AI operations engine in minutes. Your knowledge, agents, and workflows stay on your machine — local-first, open source, zero vendor lock-in. Models, dashboards, and channels are swappable adapters.

header.title: Built for Real Operations
header.subtitle: Running in production today — not a wrapper, not a toy. Free to download and run on your own infrastructure.

fabric.title: FABRIC Entity System
fabric.promise: Your knowledge graph is the Heart — entities, relationships, and context you own forever.
fabric.technical: The FABRIC entity system stores all venture knowledge as structured entities with typed relationships. Full REST API for CRUD operations. SQLite-backed with FTS5 full-text search.

synapse.title: Synapse Knowledge Index
synapse.promise: Hybrid search across your entire knowledge base — keyword + semantic. Millisecond retrieval.
synapse.technical: FTS5 keyword search combined with vector embeddings. Your AI agents find the exact right document or memory every time — understanding intent, not just keywords.

routing.title: Multi-LLM Routing
routing.promise: Route requests to the right AI model automatically. Cost, quality, speed — you set the strategy.
routing.technical: Runtime Adapter Layer with provider-agnostic routing. Registry pattern supports any LLM backend. Per-call cost tracking and intelligent model selection.

missions.title: Mission Engine
missions.promise: Define objectives, track progress, coordinate agents. Multi-step workflows with human review gates.
missions.technical: Full mission lifecycle: define → plan → execute → review → complete. Dashboard page at /missions with real-time status tracking.

dreaming.title: Dreaming & Trust Policy
dreaming.promise: Background reflection and continuous improvement. The system gets smarter while you sleep.
dreaming.technical: Dreaming subsystem processes daily interactions and suggests improvements. Trust Policy scores each proposal. Dashboard at /dreams.

eventlog.title: Event Log & SOUL Identity
eventlog.promise: Full audit trail of every action. Your venture identity encoded and versioned.
eventlog.technical: Structured event logging with typed events. SOUL identity layer stores venture voice, methodology, and rules as versionable artifacts.

security.title: Enterprise Security
security.promise: Local-first by design. Your data never leaves your infrastructure.
security.technical: Role-based access control. AES-256 encrypted credential vault. Prompt injection detection. Full audit logging.

cli.title: FABRIC Operator CLI
cli.promise: Manage your system from the command line. Init, serve, index, status — everything at your fingertips.
cli.technical: Python CLI with init, serve, bot, status, and index commands. Docker compose integration. GitHub Actions CI/CD templates.

founder.title: Built from Real Operations
founder.p1: RealizeOS was born from the Realization Group's everyday work — a production engine running international architecture, real estate, and venture operations daily across 3 regions.
founder.p2: I built this because the alternative was breaking down. Trying to scale physical, complex ventures using scattered AI tools was exhausting. I needed absolute clarity and total control. RealizeOS is the engine I built to buy back my freedom — now it's open source so you can reclaim yours.

heart.title: The Core (You Own)

limbs.title: Execution Layer (Swappable)

skin.title: Interface Layer (Swappable)

F.title: Foundations

items.question: Is RealizeOS really free?
items.answer: Yes. RealizeOS is free to download and run. It is licensed under the Business Source License (BSL) 1.1, which lets you use it in production for your own business. The one thing you can't do is offer RealizeOS to others as a hosted or managed service. Each version becomes Apache 2.0 four years after its release, and the whole codebase on 26 March 2030 at the latest.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer: Python 3.11+, Docker (recommended), and API keys for your chosen LLM providers (Anthropic, Google AI, OpenAI, and/or Ollama for fully local inference with zero external calls).

items.question: Can I host it on my own server?
items.answer: Yes. RealizeOS is designed for self-hosting. Deploy with Docker on any VPS, cloud instance, or local machine. Your FABRIC data, event log, and SOUL identity stay on your infrastructure.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Completely. RealizeOS runs on your machine or server — local-first by design. For maximum privacy, use Ollama for fully local inference — no data leaves your network at all. The only external calls are to the LLM APIs you explicitly configure.

items.question: What is the FABRIC Entity System?
items.answer: FABRIC is the Heart of RealizeOS — a structured knowledge graph that stores your venture's entities, relationships, and context. It's portable, local-first, and yours forever. Even if you swap the dashboard, the LLM provider, or the agent runtime, your FABRIC data stays intact.

items.question: What is an Audit Sprint?
items.answer: A short, paid engagement (€495). We map where time and money leak in your firm and give you priorities and quick wins. If you go on to implementation, the €495 is credited. Implementation and ongoing operation are fixed in scope and quoted after the audit.

items.question: What is 'runtime-agnostic' architecture?
items.answer: RealizeOS uses a Runtime Adapter Layer — a registry pattern that supports any LLM backend (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, and more). You can switch providers or add new ones without touching your knowledge base or workflows. Your Heart stays the same; the Limbs are swappable.

items.question: Do I get updates?
items.answer: Yes. As an open-source project on GitHub, you get access to all updates. Pull the latest changes whenever you want — on your schedule, not ours.

items.question: Can I manage multiple businesses?
items.answer: Absolutely. RealizeOS is built for multi-venture operators. Each business gets its own FABRIC entity space with isolated agents, knowledge base, and venture voice. One engine, as many ventures as you need.
